subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A', 'B' and 'C' to write five complete sentences.
stimulus: 1  5 = 5 Column 'A' Column 'B' Column 'C' (a) Bangabandhu i. declared i. for 24 years to establish the right of the people of Sheikh Mujibur ii. is Bangladesh. Rahman iii. delivered ii. the independence of Bangladesh on 26th March in (b) He iv. struggled 1971. (c) People from different v. were iii. the dreamer, founder, great political leader and walks of life vi. prepared father of the nation. iv. a splendid and significant speech on 7th March in 1971 in Race Course Maidan. v. The whole Bengali nation to fight against Pakistan. vi. deeply influenced through the delivered speech on 7th March.
guide_solution: Matching (a) Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman is the dreamer, founder, great political leader and father of the nation. (b) He declared the independence of Bangladesh on 26th March in 1971. (c) He struggled for 24 years to establish the right of the people of Bangladesh. (d) He delivered a splendid and significant speech on 7th March in 1971 in Race Course Maidan. (e) People from different walks of life were deeply influenced through the delivered speech on the 7th March.
